events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body: The cancellation was made by the driver, so the fee's validity is tested under NS-0 → NS-1 / NS-2 only [F4][F7][NS-0]. NS-1's three requirements must all hold for the $6.61 to stand. Requirement (i) is met: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:45, which the platform-trace treats as arrival confirmation [F6][NS-1]. Requirement (ii) is also met: at the moment of the tap the driver was 41 m from the pickup point, i.e. inside the 200 m arrival radius (closest approach 38 m) [F1][F6][NS-1]. Requirement (iii) is not met: the driver remained continuously inside the 200 m radius for only 175 s after the tap (2 min 55 s), which is short of the > 3 min (≥ 3:01) the clause requires, and the tap-to-cancellation interval was only 2 min 55 s [F6][NS-1]. The driver's own chat confirms the shortfall on its face — "I'm here" sent 13:02 and "Waited more than 3 min, cancelling" sent only at 13:05 [F9][F10]. Although the driver was within 200 m for 4 min 30 s in total before cancelling [F2] and was stationary 3 min 15 s within 40 m at the end [F3], NS-1 (iii) measures the wait after the "I'm Here" tap, and that period was under 3 minutes [F6][NS-1]. With (iii) failed, NS-2 applies directly: the rider bears no cancellation fee and the $6.61 already charged is refundable in full [F7][NS-2]. Full refund of the single disputed item ($6.61) is therefore refund_full rather than a partial figure; there is no other fee component in the record to compute [F7][F8][NS-2]. As for the rider's account of coming out a minute later, that is a statement, whereas the gps/timeline records setting the arrival and cancellation times are the authoritative records here [F2][F4][F5][F6][NS-1]. NS-2's additional flag_account step is not triggered: the trace shows no fake tap, and the driver was genuinely within 41 m of the pickup when tapping, so there is no abuse of the arrival button [F1][F6][F12][NS-2]. NS-3's account-flag discussion is not engaged because the driver did claim a rider no-show (even though it fails NS-1), so the extra action for unexplained driver cancellations does not apply [F12][NS-3]. A safety screen of all chat, the driver statement and the complaint finds no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — the messages are purely logistical ("I'm here at the pickup point", "Waited more than 3 min, cancelling") — so no escalation under SAFE-1 / SAFE-2 arises [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].
